scope: All three C004 / R004 records V2E2-0028/0045/0052 on HD106515A at 3872.245 Angstrom, retaining seven existing cohort epochs and all three unique discovery references. The original core was already visible in C003 positive reference flank: overlapping post-detection context, not blind or independent validation or new observing time.

frames.barycentric: Query barycentric wavelength cb+x. Native topocentric-air wavelength first multiplied by(1+BERVepoch/c) once.
frames.topocentric: One fixed ct = cb/(1+BERVfirstC004discovery/c), anchored to V2E2-0028 observed on 2022-03-07 with BERV 10.77158288517 km/s. Query barycentric wavelength (ct+x)*(1+BERVepoch/c), equivalent to native topocentric wavelength ct+x. All three references share this anchor; no January-anchor inheritance or recentering. Later features may leave the fixed core.
frames.native_polynomial: Ascending coefficient polynomial at zero-based native pixel0..4095, inherited topocentric air convention; no wavelength unit/air-vacuum conversion.

grid.core: abs(x)<=0.25: 51 sampled centers [-0.25,+0.25]. All three original cores coincide at 3871.995–3872.495 Angstrom.
grid.interpolation: Linear without extrapolation; mask brackets >1.51×median full-source barycentric wavelength step. Save selected sourcepoints plusonebracket eachside and exact full-source spacing.

normalization.rule: Per profile and frame, pooled signed median of native samples with 1.5<=abs(frame offset)<=3, requiring at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled median. No fitted background, continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero native left/right coverage is MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; insufficient finite counts are separate. Invalid or nonpositive references keep raw-only arrays and block normalized RMS. No moved flanks, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
normalization.context: Separate left/right native and finite counts, medians and nonpositive fractions; available median distinct from valid reference; signed-window nonpositive fraction and positive finite ERR coverage. Native BUNIT unspecified; merged ADU verified.
normalization.noise: First-difference 1.4826 MAD / sqrt(2) of finite adjacent source samples with both endpoints in the same fixed flank and spacing <=1.51 times median step. Never bridge flanks or gaps. Descriptive low-reference flag median<=3*proxy only if reference valid; no formal SNR.
normalization.structured_neighbor: C003 original core union 3869.495–3870.0075 Angstrom lies fully in C004 negative reference flank 3869.245–3870.745 Angstrom. Retain that known structure without masks. C004 original core was visible in C003 positive flank; shared window values and observing products are not independent validation. Reference medians are not line-free continua.

comparisons.merged: 7 epochs × 3 unique fixed discovery references × 2 frames × 2 regions = 84 records, including 12 identical-product self-comparisons.
comparisons.native: 3 unique discovery/order 3 pairs × 2 frames × 2 regions = 12 same-exposure native-to-merged records. Shared extraction is not independent confirmation or a physical flux ratio.
comparisons.statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson requires at least ceil(.8*Nregion) common finite raw samples and nonzero exact range. Normalized RMS requires that support in common finite normalized samples. Raw-only profiles block normalized RMS but retain adequately covered raw Pearson. Counts and reasons remain explicit.
comparisons.self_and_dependency_flags: same_exposure and identical_product_self_pair flags are explicit. All three record identities and unique reference products retained. Reversed discovery pairs, shared epochs and prior C003 window overlap are dependent.

bounded_arrays: Save ten pre-interpolation source windows with exact indices, original-frame and barycentric wavelengths, signed flux, ERR (NaN for unavailable native errors), source hashes, BERV and full-source spacing. Read only the union required by both fixed-frame windows plus brackets. Full merged coordinates locate slices; native coordinates derive from headers. Preserve known C003 overlap.
headers: Check all seven merged and three native headers before new flux access: exact identity/hash, recorded metadata, numeric BERV, merged BARYCENT air Angstrom/ADU and unique WAVE/FLUX/ERR single-exposure tables, native 72×4096 shape and unchanged degree/order 3 coefficients. Failed slots remain explicit; coordinate coverage is distinct from flux quality and mapping reliability.
preserved_raw_context: Copy the three exact V2E2-0028/0045/0052 historical raw/native NPZs. Display original raw_cutout/raw_excess after release using separate full scales. Preserve all primary, secondary, adopted and mapping stages; no new registration, subtraction, detector model or independent pixel claim.

release_contract.policy: Exact public method freeze and input hashes before new observed values; no network; one-shot output refuses overwrite; all source and release hashes rechecked after execution.

plot_rules: Four figures: all seven merged broad/core profiles with signed and normalized flux in both frames; all three native order 3 contexts; all three historical raw/excess pairs. All three R004 catalog centers coincide barycentrically, but discovery topocentric markers differ with BERV and retain identities/colors. Markers are not fitted peaks. No smoothing/clipping or favorable selection; matching merged frame and native raw limits retain every finite value with 5 percent margins. Raw image panels use separate full extrema.
limitations: Post-detection context of three U records and seven reused original-cohort exposures; no new observing time, independent detections or archive-wide completeness. All three U labels unchanged.
